text: 记者获悉，曾管理全球最大货币市场基金“天弘余额宝”长达十年的基金经理王登峰，已从贝莱德基金离职。他或离沪返京，转投另一家公募基金公司。资料显示，王登峰为经济学硕士，2009年7月至2012年5月，任中信建投证券固定收益部高级经理；2012年5月加入天弘基金，历任固定收益研究员、基金经理，同年8月起管理天弘现金管家货币市场基金；2013年5月底，开始管理天弘余额宝，是余额宝第一任基金经理；2021年6月，陆续有其他基金经理加入余额宝的管理行列。（中国基金报）
text_en: The reporter learned that Wang Dengfeng, the fund manager who managed the world's largest money market fund, Tianhong Yu'e Bao, for ten years, has left BlackRock Fund. He may leave Shanghai and return to Beijing to join another public fund company. According to public information, Wang Dengfeng holds a master's degree in economics. From July 2009 to May 2012, he served as a senior manager in the fixed income department of China Securities. In May 2012, he joined Tianhong Fund, where he served successively as a fixed income researcher and fund manager, and from August of the same year managed the Tianhong Cash Manager Money Market Fund. At the end of May 2013, he began managing Tianhong Yu'e Bao and was its first fund manager. In June 2021, other fund managers successively joined the management of Yu'e Bao. (China Fund News)
